title: Regex Field
summary: Flags regexes that look right but match too much or hang: unescaped dots, missing anchors, greedy wildcards and catastrophic backtracking.
description: Regex input with static checks (unescaped dot, missing ^…$, greedy .*, nested quantifiers like (a+)+), plain-English hints, one-tap fixes, and live test strings matched in a time-capped Web Worker so a runaway pattern can't freeze the page.
catches: Unescaped . where a literal dot was likely meant
Missing ^…$ anchors that let partial matches pass
Greedy .* that swallows more than intended
Nested quantifiers prone to catastrophic backtracking
Test strings that pass or fail against your expectation, or time out
limits: Checks JavaScript regex syntax; other engines (PCRE, RE2, Python) differ
Static checks are heuristics; a flagged pattern can be intentional and a clean one can still be wrong
The Worker time cap protects this page, not wherever you run the pattern later
a11y: Visible <label> on the pattern input with aria-invalid and hints via aria-describedby
Hints render in a polite live region; syntax errors use role=alert
Each test string, expectation toggle and remove button has an aria-label
Pass/fail/timeout shown with distinct icons plus the toggle's accessible name; the highlight backdrop is aria-hidden
server: Apply your own timeout or a linear-time engine (e.g. RE2) wherever user-supplied patterns run on the server.
